description: This file contains a helper function 'fill_asn1_paging_message' that converts a 'cu_cp_paging_message' type into ASN.1 format, including setting various paging message fields and associated data structures.

methods.name: fill_asn1_paging_message
methods.description: Converts a cu_cp_paging_message into ASN.1 format, setting fields such as ue_id_idx_value, paging_id, paging_drx, paging_prio, paging_cell_list, paging_origin, and paging_edrx_info.
